notes.title: Announcement: Delay of The Horrors Origins
notes.notes:
I'm sorry to announce that The Horrors Origins will be delayed until February next year due to several challenges:

[list]
[*]The playtime is currently too short (1h25m - 1h40m).
There are numerous bugs to address.
The storyline contains several gaps.
We're experiencing a creative block.
[/list]

We appreciate your understanding and patience. This extra time will enable us to deliver a polished and engaging experience, unlike the issues faced in Stay Still 1 and 2. Please look forward to this improved masterpiece.
